rationale: The last five 1-minute candles show a steady, low-volume drift lower (12.56 → 12.51) with volume collapsing to near-zero (119 shares on the final bar), indicating no conviction from either side and a lack of tradeable momentum. With 99 minutes to close and no structural setup forming, the risk/reward does not justify entry.
